This Week’s Highlights for Students

Timely Information

LOST ITEMS!

All lost items (water bottles, clothing, lunch boxes, etc) will be on a table starting Tuesday, October 13th through Thursday, October 15th.  Please go through these items to see if they belong to you! They will be donated by the end of the week!

Missed Photo Retake Day?

Now & Forever will be hosting an in-studio make-up picture day at their Los Gatos studio, giving you another opportunity to have your school photo taken or retaken.

Please note: Photos taken on this make-up day will not be included in the yearbook, as the yearbook photos have already been processed.

Date: 10/12/2026 (No Classes Today)
Time: 2-5 p.m.
Location: 100 Cooper Ct., Suite C, Los Gatos, CA 95032
No appointment necessary - families can arrive anytime between 2 pm and 5 pm

Guidance & Counseling Announcements

Class of 2027: On Wednesday, October 14, Saint Francis High School will be offering seniors an opportunity to take the SAT exam.

Class of 2028: All juniors are automatically registered to take the PSAT on Wednesday, October 14th.

Class of 2029: All sophomores are automatically registered to take the PreAct on Wednesday, October 14th.

If you have any questions please contact the Testing Coordinator
